_comment: QuantZhai search config template. Copy to config/user/search.json and fill in your SearXNG base URL. Never commit config/user/search.json.
_profiles_comment: Override profile definitions here. Omit to inherit from config/default/search.json.
_routing_comment: Override routing here. Omit to inherit defaults.
_disabled_comment: Add engine names to disable them for your instance.

compatibility._comment: Set legacy_policy_path to use an existing search-policy.json for web_search_profiles routing.
